about_page.seo_description: Vietlabel provides label design and printing solutions for the food and beverage, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, industrial, and agricultural sectors.
about_page.title: About Us
about_page.intro: Founded in 2019, Vietlabel Trading & Manufacturing Joint Stock Company provides label design and printing solutions for the food and beverage, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, industrial, and agricultural sectors.
about_page.approach: With a focus on investing in technology and improving product quality, Vietlabel pays close attention to every stage—from material consultation to printing and finishing. We strive to become a trusted partner, helping businesses enhance product value and build distinctive brand recognition in the market.
about_page.vision_text: To become a high-tech label printing facility with diverse technologies and automated operations that meet international standards.
about_page.mission_text: We believe labels are more than a way to identify products—they connect businesses with consumers. Vietlabel is committed to delivering high-quality label solutions that help build brands and support sustainable business growth, contributing to the economy and creating value for society.
about_page.history_subtitle: From a small print shop to a 10,000 m² high-tech packaging manufacturing facility.

values.title: VALUE VIETLABEL BRINGS TO BUSINESSES
values.subtitle: We don't merely manufacture packaging; we partner with you to engineer solutions that protect and celebrate your brand identity.
values.tab1_title: TAILORED LABELING SOLUTIONS FOR EACH PRODUCT
values.tab1_desc: From design concepts to finished products, VIETLABEL combines material consulting, printing technology, and processing to meet the specific requirements of each product. Every solution aims to balance brand identity, functionality, and deployment costs.
values.tab2_desc: VIETLABEL focuses on quality control from data preparation to printing and finishing. Colors, content, dimensions, and specifications are cross-checked with agreed requirements, ensuring product consistency and suitability for use.
values.tab3_desc: From food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics to electronics and industrial applications, VIETLABEL provides various label lines tailored to industry specifics. RFID, heat-resistant, anti-counterfeit, and warranty labels expand our capability to meet specialized needs.
values.tab4_desc: Combining Flexo, Offset, and Letterpress printing technologies with design and processing, VIETLABEL develops label solutions tailored to each requirement. Technology helps actualize ideas, creating a unique mark for products through every label.
values.tab5_desc: The VIETLABEL team listens to needs, advises on solutions, and coordinates with customers throughout the deployment process. Proactiveness, a sense of responsibility, and a clear working method form the foundation for building trust and long-term partnerships.

solutions.title: Our 3-Step Comprehensive Solution
solutions.subtitle: A transparent, structured workflow engineered to save operational time and optimize your procurement budget
solutions.step1_desc: Direct access to FSC-certified paperboard supplies, accommodating orders from pilot validation batches to multi-million production runs with agile lead times.
solutions.step2_desc: Expert structural engineering to maximize sheet imposition efficiency, minimize trim waste, and engineer flat-packing geometries that cut logistics costs.
solutions.step3_desc: Customizable surface embellishments: holographic cold/hot foil stamping, tactile sand varnishing, soft-touch matte lamination, and laser-precise window patching.
